sub_sector.value: chlor alkali and vinyls; epoxy materials; small caliber ammunition

manufacturing_type.detail: Continuous chemical processing (chlor alkali, epoxy); ammunition produced in high-volume manufacturing and loading lines.

production_model.detail: Bulk chemicals and ammunition produced to inventory and sold from stock and under contracts.

product_complexity.detail: Largely commodity chlor alkali and epoxy materials, with some specialty grades and branded ammunition.

production_role.detail: Produces chlorine, caustic soda, epoxy materials as inputs; Winchester sells finished ammunition.

end_market_exposure.detail: Chemicals into water treatment, infrastructure, composites, wind/hydrogen, pharma; Winchester ammunition to sporting, hunting and military/law enforcement buyers.

notes: Ammunition manufacturing details and end-market mix partly from general knowledge.
